Baseline observation: 17 health actors at 9 locations; 8 exact coincident pairs in late cache
Change: Redistributed only the duplicate from each pair along the east/north/west route
Test and result: Two fresh UE 5.4 commandlet sessions: 17 distinct locations, 17 actors. Simulation: downward visibility trace hits beneath all 17.
Limit of evidence: Surface hits do not prove unobstructed walking or pickup collection. One trace at (3500,550) hits z156; other relocated positions hit z100.

Baseline observation: Map instance FireSpeed tier 1-5: 0.50 / 0.10 / 0.05 / 0.50 / 0.01 s; tier 4 reverses cadence.
Change: Set eight map instances to 0.65 / 0.52 / 0.42 / 0.34 / 0.28 s; preserve all five enemy classes and routes.
Test and result: Two fresh UE sessions verified all eight serialized overrides and counts 1/2/2/1/2.
Limit of evidence: Configured interval, not measured projectile rate, damage, survival or human difficulty.

Baseline observation: No PointLight actors in baseline facility
Change: Added localized arming, relay, crossing and vault landmarks
Test and result: Both reloads: four lights, intensity 3600 and radius 540 cm each.

Baseline observation: No AmbientSound actors in baseline facility
Change: Added two original three-second mono loops: ascending relay pair and low descending vault warning; localized falloff.
Test and result: Both reloads: separate looping, auto-activated waves, falloff 420 cm. Simulation reported is_playing=true for both.
Limit of evidence: Playback state is not an acoustic recording or listening test.

Baseline observation: Original Toss (R) called INT_Drop and AddForce but never cleared isHolding?; HUD kept "HELD" and the next E press only re-dropped the key (BP_PlayerChar bytecode, docs/evidence/bp-disasm).
Change: SectorThrow clears isHolding? when the thrown key it released is the player's HitObject.
Test and result: Packaged build-06: is_holding_after_toss=false in 3/3 repeat runs and the final recorded run; E then opened Door 2 without a wasted press.
Limit of evidence: Scripted runs only; no human playtest.

Baseline observation: Thrown key slid about 600 units after landing (run 2: rest [2332,-815,112]); the preview ring did not show where it stopped.
Change: On the first floor-like contact (normal Z > 0.7) SectorThrow zeroes horizontal and angular velocity; walls keep their bounce.
Test and result: Editor run 3 and later: key settled within 10 units of the predicted landing point.
Limit of evidence: Landing settle applies to keys thrown or dropped by the player, not to keys knocked by other objects.

Baseline observation: Key landing on the 30-unit plate could drift off; the original Button EndOverlap sets TargetDoor.isUnlocked=false, so Door 2 re-locked (package build-05: unlocked at 18.02 s, re-locked at 18.55 s).
Change: A key whose landing overlaps a pressure plate is seated at the plate centre and put to sleep.
Test and result: Package build-06: 3/3 repeat runs and the final run logged "SectorThrow seated ... at X=2740 Y=-1365"; key_rest [2740,-1365,116]; Door 2 stayed unlocked.
Limit of evidence: Verified on the first plate (pink); other six plates use the same Blueprint but were not exercised.

Baseline observation: Arc (2 px) and ring (radius 12) were hard to read at 400 units and were hidden by the gun model.
Change: Arc 4 px, ring sized to the key footprint, 45-unit landing pin, all drawn in the foreground depth group.
Test and result: Final-run screenshot 05_throw_preview.png and video at the throw step show the green ring and pin over the gun.
Limit of evidence: Visual check by the author only.

Baseline observation: Forced-GC test crashed (EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION in GC reference traversal). Audit: native ASectorNineSentinel::Pivot held the Elapsed float in all 8 monsters; the compiled .obj and the regenerated reflection data came from different header versions (file timestamps preserved by an earlier copy).
Change: Deleted plugin Intermediate/Binaries and rebuilt; later syncs copy without preserving timestamps. No source change was needed.
Test and result: After the clean rebuild: 15/15 forced GCs with audit bad=0 (editor run 6); packaged build-06: 7/7 forced GCs in every run. A/B with the original turret did not crash. Excerpts: docs/evidence/defects/gc-crash-investigation.txt.
Limit of evidence: Build-process defect, not a gameplay-code defect; no engine symbols were available, so the faulting function is identified only by its nearest export.

Baseline observation: Original Blueprints print developer strings on screen ("It is not PhysicsPickup", damage values, "hit").
Test and result: Packaged screenshots 06_door_unlocked and 07_combat no longer show the prints (compare editor run screenshots before the change).
Limit of evidence: The PrintString nodes remain in the Blueprints; they are hidden, not removed.

Baseline observation: Tier-1 enemy at 0.65 s x 10 damage: a perfect-aim scripted player killed it with 10/11 hits but ended at 10/100 health.
Change: Set the single BP_Monster_Lv1 map instance FireSpeed to 1.00 s; tiers 2-5 unchanged (0.52 / 0.42 / 0.34 / 0.28 s).
Test and result: Two fresh commandlet readbacks (verify.py FACILITY_PASS, rates 1.0/0.52/0.42/0.34/0.28). Packaged runs: enemy destroyed after 11 shots with the player at 40/100 health in 4/4 runs.
Limit of evidence: Measured with scripted perfect aim at about 400 units; tiers 2-5 were not measured; no human difficulty test.

Baseline observation: No gameplay video of the refined loop.
Change: Recorded only the game window (PrintWindow) during the packaged scripted run.
Test and result: yun_daniel_artifact3_gameplay.mp4: 47.07 s, 1280x720, 30 fps; 84 of 1412 frames repeated to keep real time.
Limit of evidence: The video has no audio track: the recorded run was started with -nosound. An earlier in-engine submix recording produced 6.19 s of digital silence (-91 dB) for a 34 s span, so it was not used.
